title: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 5: Breaking Point

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A pyromancer planeswalker tormented by headaches and memories that aren't hers; she is convinced Jace plans to use the giant archaic and tries to kill it.

entities.name: Ajani
entities.description: A leonin planeswalker and Chandra's old mentor, who doubts her visions but stops her from killing the archaic.

entities.name: Oracle Jadzi
entities.description: An old oracle of Arcavios, abducted by the giant archaic, who tends its wounds and warns that the plane's future is threatened.

entities.name: Jace
entities.description: A figure Chandra believes is behind the threat to Arcavios and plans to use the archaic.

entities.name: Ashiok
entities.description: A planeswalker Ajani suggests could be planting images in Chandra's head.

entities.name: Pia
entities.description: A person whose features Ajani sees echoed in Chandra's face.

entities.name: Jaya
entities.description: A person whose features Ajani sees echoed in Chandra's face.

entities.name: Lluwen
entities.description: A student who, with others, feared the worst for Jadzi.

entities.name: Professor Vess
entities.description: A professor Jadzi calls a capable hand for untangling the problem.

entities.name: Professor Fel
entities.description: A professor Jadzi calls a capable hand for untangling the problem.

entities.name: The Giant Archaic
entities.description: The last archaic, a huge wounded being that flickers in and out of existence and is tended by Jadzi.

entities.name: Archaics
entities.description: Oracles who, on dying, are flung back through history and transformed into huge beings.

entities.name: The Nexus
entities.description: A swirl of unstable magical energy in the titan's skull that looks like a snarl and seems to be at the core of the threat to Arcavios's future.

entities.name: Titan's Grave
entities.description: A place on Arcavios with tunnels beneath, and a titan's empty skull in which the characters find the archaic.

entities.name: Arcavios
entities.description: The plane whose future is threatened.

events.summary: Chandra and Ajani walk silently through the tunnels below Titan's Grave.
events.quote: Two Planeswalkers trudged through the tunnels below Titan's Grave. Neither of them said a word.

events.summary: Chandra stumbles in a vision and Ajani catches her by the cloak, then pulls back his hand mid-pat.
events.quote: Ajani caught her by the hood of her cloak.

events.summary: Ajani wonders whether Chandra's visions might be Ashiok's work and descends behind her.
events.quote: It could be Ashiok planting these images in her head.

events.summary: They hear the archaic wail and Jadzi's voice from ahead.
events.quote: They heard the archaic before they saw it.

events.summary: They find Jadzi healing the wounded archaic in the titan's skull, opposite a snarl-like swirl of energy.
events.quote: Jadzi kneeled in its palm, still, working a complex healing spell across its flesh.

events.summary: Chandra holds back from striking the wounded archaic.
events.quote: It would be so easy. So why did she hesitate?

events.summary: Jadzi, already aware of them, calls out the girl sneaking up on them.
events.quote: There's a girl who thinks she can sneak up on us,

events.summary: Jadzi explains that archaics are oracles flung back in time after death, and that this archaic is the last.
events.quote: Archaics are oracles, like I am.

events.summary: Jadzi warns that something is threatening the future of Arcavios itself.
events.quote: "Something is threatening the future of Arcavios itself."

events.summary: Chandra insists the culprit is Jace.
events.quote: "It's Jace! I'm telling you, it's Jace."

events.summary: Jadzi explains the archaics flicker in and out of existence as Arcavios's future is meddled with.
events.quote: They've been flickering in and out of existence.

events.summary: Jadzi urges Chandra not to kill the archaic, saying that would treat the symptom and not the disease.
events.quote: Snuffing out an archaic is treating the symptom, not the disease.

events.summary: Chandra says Jace is no longer her friend and Ajani argues they cannot turn their backs on him; she rebukes him.
events.quote: I get to decide who my friends are, Ajani,

events.summary: The archaic wails and a wave of wrongness hits all three, giving Ajani glimpses of another life before it passes.
events.quote: The dizziness lingered.

events.summary: Jadzi says the swirl is some kind of nexus at the core of the problem.
events.quote: this is at the core of it."

events.summary: A tendril of the nexus touches Ajani's wrist and for a blink he feels his brother beside him.
events.quote: A tendril of it wrapped around his wrist, and for the space of a blink he felt his brother standing next to him.

events.summary: Ajani asks Chandra to work together, and she agrees while privately knowing it is a lie.
events.quote: It hurt so bad to lie to him.

events.summary: The three of them breathe in time and work to untangle the nexus's threads; Chandra collapses in pain.
events.quote: A howl left her as her knees threatened to give out from under her.

events.summary: Chandra decides to use their distraction to attack the archaic and pools fire into her right hand.
events.quote: Chandra pooled it all into her right hand.

events.summary: Ajani strikes Chandra's forearm with the flat of his axe, sending her fireball wide.
events.quote: he brought the flat of his axe down on her forearm with crushing certainty.

events.summary: Chandra declares she will go through Ajani if she must, and Ajani plants himself between her and the archaic, and they begin to fight.
events.quote: "I will stand here as long as I am able. Fire can only burn my flesh."

relations.note: He feels it is his place to mentor Chandra and guide her.
relations.quote: Who was he as a teacher if he could not bring himself to mentor Chandra here?

relations.note: Chandra wants to kill the archaic before Jace can use it.
relations.quote: "Killing the archaic before Jace can use it is our only choice.

relations.note: Jadzi tends the archaic that abducted her and cares for it.
relations.quote: She really did care for that creature, didn't she?

relations.note: Chandra says Jace is not her friend anymore.
Ajani blocks Chandra and the two end up fighting.
relations.quote: Ajani planted himself between Chandra and the ailing archaic.
